The DonutSMP world border expansion is speculated to happen in the next 2 years. This was quoted by W1zox on his live stream on July 24th of 2026. The current DonutSMP border is 225,000 Blocks away from the coordinates (0,0) in each way (+ and -). 

It will increase from 225k, -225k to 30m, -30m.

Why is the border expansion coming so late?

The reason why it is happening so late is because it takes a long time to set up these servers, especially for a server as popular as DonutSMP. Another reason is that a lot of money will have to be spent to buy physical servers to host the expansion on. This was the main reason shardshop/ other p2w features were added (stated by DrDonutt). 

== Advice ==
SELL ALL EXPENSIVE ITEMS BEFORE IT EXPANDS (you have time to do this)

After the expansion, most items of the expensive type will become practically worthless as anybody will be able to find tons whenever they want by finding unexplored regions, but a good money making strategy will be to join the moment the expansion launches and then to instantly fill old elytra orders at prices that remained the same as pre-expansion. It doesn't have a 100% chance to work as many players are smart and will withdraw orders, but some will forget or be on vacation. Flying for 20 minutes will get you many elytras. If somebody forgets about orders, you just got free billions.

The border expansion will make bases virtually unraidable, so it is recommended not to make any new bases until the border fully expands. 

* Build expensive item farming farms (like mob head farms) now though, as prices will tank after the expansion.
* Build cheap item farming farms (like kelp farms) later, as prices probably won't tank that much after the expansion.

The method of making money by farming mob heads is currently very good (as there are compact farms which can make thousands of Piglin heads worth tens of billions per storm), but after the expansion, these farms will be useless. Currently (as of 3/15/2026), Piglin heads are holding stable at around $3,800,000 each. Once the expansion happens, a lot of items (including heads) will lose practically all of their value.

=== '''Items that will most definitely ''tank'' in prices''' ===

* All expensive end items (Elytras and Dragon Heads)
* All expensive Nether things (Netherite Blocks, Netherite Ingots, Netherite Scraps, Ancient Debris, Netherite Armor, Netherite Tools, Netherite Armor Trims and Gilded Blackstone)
* Most overworld items (Deepslate emerald, enchanted golden apples)
'''DISCLAIMER:''' These items will only fall very close to the expansion date,  price dips can happen way before the expansion but once people realize nothings happening value will rise again.

=== '''Items that will stay the same''' ===

* All diamond things (Diamond Horse Armor, Diamond Armor, Diamond Blocks, Diamonds, Diamond Ore, Deepslate Diamond Ore, Diamond Tools, and Diamond Armor Trims)
* Music Discs
* All Mob Heads (Piglin Heads, Skeleton Heads, Zombie Heads and Creeper Heads)

=== '''Items that will definitely rise in prices''' ===

* All spawners
* All things from /shop (see [[Removing /Shop]])
* Anything trial chamber related (tridents, maces, wind burst books, so on, as they are have to be earned)
* Diamond nautilus shells, as they are so rare
Tridents and dms are very low rn, get them while u can

=== EVERYTHING BELOW HERE IS MY OPINION, NOT PROVEN FACTS! ===
The expansion will be helpful for new players, as it will reduce the risk of base hunters finding your base, it will open up availability for lots of materials which can be used for decoration instead of investments. A good example of this is Gilded Blackstone. It is a very cool looking block but can't be used by players who don't have a lot of money.
